public_rationale: For calendar 2025, CoreWeave reported $10.309 billion in cash capital expenditure and $3.058 billion in operating cash inflow [e1]. Their difference, $7.251 billion, is below the forecast's comparison interval of $14.5 billion to less than $15.5 billion [e1]. The September 25, 2025 OpenAI contract expansion does not establish whether the original March agreement's material 2025 delivery and payment assumptions held [e2]. On November 10, 2025, management disclosed a delivery delay and an adjusted schedule for an unnamed customer [e3]. These disclosures leave the forecast's condition unestablished, so the lower measured burn does not settle the conditional claim [e1, e2, e3].
limitations: The evidence does not establish the original OpenAI agreement's material 2025 delivery and payment schedule or performance against it [e2, e3].
The disclosed delay cannot be attributed to OpenAI from this evidence [e3].
The calculation measures cash capital expenditure less operating cash flow; it does not measure net loss or accrued capital expenditure [e1].
